_doc: Per-date editorial deck shown on the home page. Each date keys to morning/afternoon/evening cards. Days without an entry fall back to the generic 'browse the guide' deck. Edit freely — both the Next.js site and the whats-on-today skill can read this.

morning.title: Settle in, walk the dock
morning.body: Coffee on the porch, unpack, walk Egan down to see the lake. Easy first day.

afternoon.title: Doug's Fish Fry
afternoon.body: The mandatory first-day pilgrimage. Drive-thru, picnic at Clift Park if weather cooperates.

evening.title: Porch dinner + early bed
evening.body: Light grill, watch the sun drop, get Egan down by 7. Long week ahead.

morning.title: Glass-water paddle
morning.body: Wind picks up around 10. Coffee in the thermos, Egan in the cockpit, hug the west shore for shade.

afternoon.title: Skan Brewery food trucks
afternoon.body: Limp Lizard BBQ from 1pm. Big lawn, easy with Egan, lake breeze.

evening.title: BBQ + sunset on the dock
evening.body: Coals at 6. Sun behind the west hills around 8:43. Fireflies after dusk.

morning.title: Carpenter Falls — early
morning.body: Arrive by 8am for parking. Toddler-doable upper view, save the climb for later.

afternoon.title: Lake swim, long nap
afternoon.body: Quiet afternoon. Big nap for Egan. Save energy.

evening.title: Jelly Roll @ Empower FCU
evening.body: Highlighted concert — leave by 5:30, grab dinner near venue.

morning.title: Slow start, lake walk
morning.body: Coffee on the porch. Walk down to the dock. See what the day wants to be.

afternoon.title: Pick a chapter
afternoon.body: Browse the guide below — food, lake, hikes, day trips, or something for Egan.

evening.title: Dinner + sunset
evening.body: Grill at the house or head into town. Sunset around 8:40 from the dock.
